sourceRecords.title: Gazelle Wind Power Secures TUPEM Authorization to Launch its 2 MW Floating Wind Demonstrator
sourceRecords.sourceText: Gazelle secured a 10-year authorization for its 2 MW Nau Azul floating wind demonstrator off Aguçadoura, Portugal.

sourceRecords.title: Hexicon divests TwinHub floating wind project in the UK
sourceRecords.sourceText: Hexicon completed divestment of the TwinHub project company, transferring the floating wind site and liabilities to a new buyer.
